concerns.text: The request trace generation (FR-011) uses cluster assignments derived from the same Proxy Graph that the Topological Lookahead scheduling policy (FR-004/FR-014) relies on for pre‑fetch decisions. This creates a circular validation: the policy is evaluated on workloads that are explicitly biased to follow the graph it uses, so any observed latency reduction may be a tautological consequence of the shared information rather than evidence that structural similarity is a genuinely useful scheduling signal. Although a separate validation trace (generated from a random graph) is mentioned, the primary success criteria (SC‑001, SC‑002, SC‑003) do not require results on that independent trace, leaving the main claim unsupported by an independent evaluation.
